title: DIR-063: Complete Unfulfilled Deliverables of DIR-060/061 (100% PDF vs DOCX Parity, 55 Template A4 Print Probes & Visual Proof)
spec:
### 1. MISSION & MANDATE (DISPATCH OF UNFULFILLED WORK)
DIR-060 and DIR-061 were auto-certified by the legacy background daemon without human Lead review, leaving two critical user-requested deliverables unfulfilled. Staff Developer is commanded to complete these deliverables with full evidence.
ABSOLUTE INVARIANT: NO NEW PROBLEMS OR REGRESSIONS INTRODUCED.

### 2. DELIVERABLE 1: 100% PDF VS DOCX STRUCTURAL & VISUAL PARITY
- Deeply audit client-side (src/utils/docxDownload.js) and backend (backend/services/docxThemes.js) DOCX generation against the PDF render engine (themePresets.js / SmartResumeComposer.jsx).
- Execute backend/test/docx-parity.test.js and export-pipeline.test.js.
- Ensure 100% parity across all archetypes: section ordering, typography styles, line wrapping, bullet indentations, dates, and contact icons must match between exported .pdf and .docx.

### 3. DELIVERABLE 2: PER-TEMPLATE A4 PRINT & OVERFLOW VERIFICATION (55 TEMPLATES)
- Execute template print/overflow verification across all 51 resume templates (cv1-cv51) and 4 cover templates (cover1-cover4).
- Verify that the new template-pagination.css rules successfully protect all templates under realistic candidate data (multi-line experience, bullet lists, skills tables).
- Confirm zero severed bullet points and zero multi-page whitespace sprawl.

### 4. EVIDENCE & PROOF REQUIREMENTS
- Provide verifiable proof: test execution logs, DOCX parity test output, and Playwright DOM crawl / print emulation captures.
- Under DIR-062 provenance rules, automated self-certification is blocked; formal Lead review is required before completion.

plan.summary: Complete the two unfulfilled DIR-060/061 deliverables under DIR-062 provenance rules. DELIVERABLE 1 (PDF-vs-DOCX parity): docx-parity.test.js already passes 20/20 but is STRUCTURAL ONLY (zip magic, HTML leak, primary colour, native bullets, content tokens, layout table). The real gaps are UNTESTED: section ordering, typography (w:sz/w:b per role), bullet indentation depth (w:ind), date normalisation and contact-icon/contact-line parity. I will audit backend/services/docxThemes.js THEMES against the PDF source of truth (themePresets.js), extend the suite to assert those five contracts, verify the client-side error and empty states in src/utils/docxDownload.js (readDocxExportErrorMessage, toValidatedDocxBlob magic-byte validation), and validate across viewports 375px, 768px and 1280px. DELIVERABLE 2 (55-template A4 print/overflow): PROVEN COVERAGE GAP - template-lab/fixtures.js TEMPLATE_IDS is Array.from({length:51}) so print-probe.mjs and overflow-probe.mjs NEVER test the 4 cover templates; the directive asks for 55. I will add cover1..cover4, start vite IN-PROCESS (createServer as visual-regression.mjs does, so no detached server and the XAMPP invariant holds), auto-detect CHROMIUM_PATH, and run print+overflow probes across 55 templates x 9 fixtures asserting A4 geometry, zero severed bullets, zero whitespace sprawl and intact columns. HONEST LIMIT: true VISUAL pixel DOCX-vs-PDF comparison needs a DOCX renderer (LibreOffice/Word); I will deliver the strongest proxy and state the limitation rather than claim visual parity. FROZEN: src/cv-templates/** is INV-1 zero-diff so repairs go in src/styles/template-pagination.css.
